alt: The complete, signed PDF document of the Notice of Statutory Exhaustion and CDSS Default filed on June 16, 2026, in Case SHN-105273296.
full_text: NOTICE OF STATUTORY EXHAUSTION AND CDSS DEFAULT. TO: California Department of Social Services State Hearings Division. CASE NAME: HERNANDEZ, NICOLAS. CASE NUMBER: SHN-105273296. DATE OF FILING: March 15, 2026. STATUTORY DUE DATE: June 15, 2026. Under 42 CFR 431.244 and MPP 22-060, the State is required to hold a hearing and issue a decision within 90 days. Because L.A. Care has persistently withheld my mandated reimbursement, I was forced out of my medically supervised benzodiazepine tapering program. My treating provider issued a final 28-day emergency supply on June 8, 2026, running out on July 6, 2026. I demand immediate scheduling. Dated: June 16, 2026. Nicolas Hernandez.
summary: The complete Notice of Statutory Exhaustion and CDSS Default document filed in the ACMS portal on June 16, 2026. It documents the federal and state timeline violations, details the clinical crisis of the benzodiazepine taper cutoff, specifies the July 6, 2026, medication expiration deadline, and serves as formal notice of administrative collapse and complete exhaustion of remedies prior to judicial enforcement.
